# Atlas typography

- atlas-serif.woff: Noto Serif SC Regular, served as CSS family Atlas Serif. Source: https://fonts.google.com/noto/specimen/Noto+Serif+SC
- atlas-sans.woff: Noto Sans SC Regular, served as CSS family Atlas Sans. Source: https://fonts.google.com/noto/specimen/Noto+Sans+SC

Subsets generated with fontTools from the official Google Fonts TTFs, keeping characters used in this static app and its public place/classification datasets. Font outlines are unchanged. The respective SIL Open Font License files accompany these subsets. Fonts are self-hosted; system fonts cover any later text beyond the included glyphs. No fonts or code were copied from the reference website.
